content: The TCT 2010 schedule outlines the coordination of television events during the conference. Filming will occur in an open studio located on the 3rd floor of the convention center, just outside the Main Arena (Ballroom A, B, C). Available time slots are marked in red. Below is the detailed schedule for each day: Wednesday, September 22, 2010 2:00 PM 2:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Thomas Zeller Trial: DES-BTK A prospective, double-blind, randomized trial comparing polymer-free sirolimus-eluting stents to bare metal stents in patients with infrapopliteal disease. Embargo lift: 12 PM on Friday, September 24th. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Jean-Philippe Collet Trial: CLOVIS-2 A prospective, randomized, nested case-control crossover study evaluating high versus low clopidogrel loading doses in clopidogrel-resistant patients, with and without the CYP2C192 loss-of-function allele. Embargo lift: 7 PM on Wednesday, September 22nd. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Martin Leon Trial: PARTNER A prospective randomized trial comparing transcatheter aortic valve implantation to standard therapy in patients with inoperable aortic stenosis. Embargo lift: 11 AM on Thursday, September 23rd. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Robert-Jan van Geuns Trial: APPOSITION II A prospective randomized trial comparing self-expanding stents to balloon-expandable stents in patients with acute myocardial infarction. Embargo lift: 6:45 PM on Wednesday, September 22nd. 4:00 PM 4:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Gennaro Sardella Trial: ROMA A prospective randomized trial investigating rosuvastatin pretreatment prior to percutaneous coronary intervention. Embargo lift: 7:45 PM on Tuesday, September 21st. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Elvin Kedhi Trial: COMPARE-AMI Two-year outcomes from a prospective randomized trial comparing everolimus-eluting stents to paclitaxel-eluting stents in patients with STEMI. Embargo lift: 7:30 PM on Friday, September 24th. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Gregg W. Stone Trial: SPIRIT IV and HORIZONS-AMI SPIRIT IV: Two-year results from a prospective randomized trial comparing everolimus-eluting stents to paclitaxel-eluting stents in patients with coronary artery disease. HORIZONS-AMI: Three-year follow-up from a prospective randomized trial of antithrombin strategies and drug-eluting stents in patients with acute myocardial infarction undergoing primary angioplasty. Embargo lift: 11:24 AM on Thursday, September 23rd (SPIRIT IV) and 11:24 AM on Saturday, September 25th (HORIZONS-AMI). Thursday, September 23, 2010 9:45 AM 10:15 AM Interviewee: Dr. Rajesh M. Dave Trial: CRYSTAL AMI A prospective randomized trial comparing intracoronary site-specific abciximab to intravenous abciximab in patients with acute myocardial infarction undergoing primary angioplasty. Embargo lift: 7 PM on Friday, September 24th. 10:15 AM 10:45 AM Interviewee: Dr. Dimitrios Alexopoulos Trial: PRO-GR A prospective, randomized, crossover study comparing maintenance high-dose clopidogrel to prasugrel in clopidogrel-resistant patients, with and without the CYP2C192 loss-of-function allele. Embargo lift: 7:15 PM on Wednesday, September 22nd. 11:15 AM 11:45 AM Interviewee: Dr. Eberhard Grube Trial: BIOFREEDOM A prospective randomized trial comparing polymer-free biolimus A9-eluting stents to paclitaxel-eluting stents in patients with coronary artery disease. Embargo lift: 12 PM on Saturday, September 25th. 1:00 PM 1:20 PM Interviewee: Dr. Shmuel Banai Trial: BLAST A prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of a monocyte-depleting agent after bare metal stent implantation in patients with coronary artery disease. Embargo lift: 12:30 PM on Friday, September 24th. 1:20 PM 1:50 PM Interviewee: Dr. Bernhard Meier Trial: PFO Closure A prospective, nonrandomized, propensity-adjusted study comparing PFO closure to medical therapy in patients with stroke presumably related to PFO. Embargo lift: 7:45 PM on Wednesday, September 22nd. 3:50 PM 4:10 PM Interviewee: Dr. Jochen Wöhrle Trial: PERFECT STENT A prospective randomized trial evaluating a paclitaxel-eluting balloon in patients treated with endothelial progenitor cell-capturing stents for de novo coronary artery disease. Embargo lift: 12:30 PM on Thursday, September 23rd. Friday, September 24, 2010 2:00 PM 2:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Julinda Mehilli Trial: ISAR-TEST-5 A prospective randomized trial comparing polymer-free sirolimus-/probucol-eluting stents to zotarolimus-eluting stents in patients with coronary artery disease. Embargo lift: 11 AM on Saturday, September 25th. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Martyn R. Thomas Trial: SOURCE TAVI Cohort 2 A prospective observational study of over 2,300 lower-risk and valve-in-valve patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation. Embargo lift: 7:30 PM on Wednesday, September 22nd. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Robert A. Byrne Trial: ISAR-TEST-4 Two-year clinical and angiographic outcomes from a prospective randomized trial comparing everolimus-eluting stents to sirolimus-eluting stents in patients with coronary artery disease. Embargo lift: 11:42 AM on Friday, September 24th. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Mohsen Sharifi Trial: TORPEDO A prospective randomized trial comparing percutaneous endovenous intervention to anticoagulation alone in patients with deep venous thrombosis. Embargo lift: 12:15 PM on Friday, September 24th. 4:00 PM 4:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Michelle O'Donoghue Trial: LANCELOT ACS A prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of a reversible PAR-1 thrombin receptor antagonist in patients with acute coronary syndromes. Embargo lift: 12 PM on Thursday, September 23rd. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Michael D. Dake Trial: ZILVER PTX A prospective randomized trial comparing a paclitaxel-eluting stent to balloon angioplasty with provisional bare metal stenting in patients with superficial femoral artery disease. Embargo lift: 11 AM on Friday, September 24th. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM Interviewee: Dr. Antonio Colombo Trial: AVIO A prospective randomized trial comparing intravascular ultrasound-guided stent implantation to angiography-guided stent implantation in complex coronary lesions. Embargo lift: 12:15 PM on Saturday, September 25th. Saturday, September 25, 2010 10:30 AM 11:00 AM Interviewee: Dr. Bernard R. Chevalier Trial: CRISTAL A prospective randomized trial comparing sirolimus-eluting stents to balloon angioplasty for restenosis of drug-eluting coronary stents. Embargo lift: 11:42 AM on Saturday, September 25th. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM Interviewee: Dr. Antonio L. Bartorelli Trial: MYTHOS A prospective randomized trial of furosemide-induced high-volume diuresis with matched hydration using a dedicated device to prevent contrast nephropathy. Embargo lift: 6:15 PM on Friday, September 24th. 11:30 AM 12:00 PM Interviewee: Dr. Dominick J. Angiolillo Trial: SWAP Trial Embargo lift: (Details not provided).
